name: Dyson_money
fix_description: Classic vault share inflation (first depositor attack). In deposit(), when totalSupply()==0, an attacker can manipulate the share price by depositing 1 wei then donating tokens directly to inflate balance(). Fix: mint a minimum number of dead shares on first deposit (e.g., mint 1000 shares to address(0)), or require a minimum initial deposit amount.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a short, direct business-logic exploit against a single protocol flow: repeatedly borrow/redeem, then drain liquidity and swap out. It requires little DeFi sophistication beyond understanding basic token approvals and a final swap, with no flash loan, complex routing, or deep multi-contract state reasoning.
